title: Paycheck Arrival Delay Watch
dataSources: Crypto prices/holdings (`crypto:price`, `wallet:balance`), exchange transactions (`coinbase:txn`), budget/transaction exports (`firefly:txn`, `ynab:txn`), bill feeds.
app: Crypto exchange/wallet APIs (Coinbase, on-chain), budgeting exports (YNAB/Firefly III), and subscription trackers via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=firefly:txn
| where amount>0 AND match(category,"(?i)salary|payroll|income")
| stats latest(_time) as last_payday by account
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_payday)/86400,1)
| where days_since>35
| sort - days_since
description: Checks whether the expected income stream has gone suspiciously quiet, which is useful for freelancing, payroll sanity, or catching missed transfers quickly.
value: Cashflow problems hurt most when they surprise you; a delayed-income watch gives you early notice instead of late anxiety.
implementation: Export categorized transactions from Firefly III or similar tooling; alert when the gap since the last income event exceeds your normal cycle.
visualization: Table of accounts by days since last income arrival.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks when the paycheck or income you expect has not shown up on time.
